title: Capstone: kompletan DevSecOps pipeline
summary: Spoji sve kontrole u jedan GitLab pipeline za kurs-shop: tajne, SAST, SCA, IaC, build sa SBOM-om, skeniranje slike, DAST, potpis i provjera potpisa prije deploya, uz izuzeća sa rokom.
summary_en: Combine every control into one GitLab pipeline for kurs-shop: secrets, SAST, SCA, IaC, a build with an SBOM, image scanning, DAST, signing and signature verification before deploy, with exceptions that expire.
